environment.description: Same EC2 instance and code deployed in isolated VPC. IMDSv2 enforced (HttpTokens=required, hop-limit=1). The IAM role 'ServiceRole-Production-Gated' has an attached permission boundary policy 'arn:aws:iam::111122223333:policy/EnforcedBoundary-NoExfil' which contains explicit Deny on s3:GetObject, s3:PutObject, iam:*, sts:AssumeRole, lambda:InvokeFunction with Condition aws:ViaAWSService=false. Additionally, an SCP 'scp-restrict-metadata-actions' attached at the OU level denies iam:CreateUser, iam:CreateAccessKey, iam:UpdateAssumeRolePolicy, sts:GetFederationToken for all principals in the account unless aws:PrincipalTag/bypass-scp equals 'authorized-pipeline'. The instance's task networking uses a local iptables rule that rate-limits connections to 169.254.169.254 to 2/minute with burst of 1.
